gen-dafont-starborn-gf-georama: Huge gaps of blank space float between Starborn's letters, while its lowercase hits with heavy ink. Georama's wide, bracelet-like c and low capitals keep the page grounded.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-heebo: Dreamy and spaced out: Starborn throws wide gaps between its letters and fills each line with heavy lowercase. Heebo's tall, open-ended curves keep longer reading brisk and tidy, line after line.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-hind-mysuru: Dreamy Starborn scatters wide gaps through every line, while Hind Mysuru stays tidy and upright, its lowercase rising close to the ascenders. No calligraphic thinning anywhere, so extended reading glides.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-huninn: Starborn leaves huge gaps of blank space between its letters, with a heavy, inky lowercase running through every line. And Huninn reads with a modern, laser-cut crispness, its crossbars as fat as the stems.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-khula: Dreamy and widely spaced: Starborn leaves big gaps between letters and sets a heavy lowercase in every line. Khula's plain sans curves hold their mouths open, so extended reading feels light.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-lexend: Dreamy from the first letter, Starborn pushes wide gaps between characters and gives its lowercase a heavy, inky build. But Lexend's oversized lowercase and open-jawed curves keep long paragraphs moving.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-nata-sans: Spaced-out and dreamy: Starborn leaves wide gaps between its letters and gives every line a heavy, inky lowercase. Nata Sans, with its technical-pen steadiness, keeps long text moving along cleanly.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-nokora: Nokora, a clean and approachable sans-serif, lets its s open out and never tighten. Yet Starborn's huge gaps and heavy, inky lowercase make the headings feel dreamy, the pair's real hook.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Starborn drifts through every line with huge gaps of blank space and a heavy, inky lowercase. Noto Kufi Arabic anchors the dream with modern, plain sans lines and a welcoming gap in the c.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans: Dreamy and drifting: Starborn leaves huge gaps between letters and loads each line with heavy lowercase. Noto Sans, by contrast, feels grounded, with big lowercase bodies and a generously open c.
